name: X Audit
tagline: Sweeps your own X history for posts that could age badly and sorts them by risk
description: Point it at your profile and it walks posts, replies, quotes and reposts, flagging anything that could read badly out of context. Each finding lands in one of three buckets: unambiguous, debatable, or the kind that screenshots poorly. It can hide or remove what you sign off on, so read the list before letting it act.
author: Divine_machine
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
